contexts.text: A border (of gold on the ark) () = termination from good lest they be approached and injured by evils. A border = termination. Explained. AC 10187.
The border had reference to the circumference (in man) in which there is termination.
Thou shalt make for (the table) a border of gold round about () = the termination of the sphere of good from the Lord's Divine good.
Thou shalt make a border of gold of the closure round about () = the termination of the sphere of Divine good.
A lip, or border, round the upper opening of the robe () = terminated and closed on every side.
(The departed believed to be in limbo.)

After death... man retains the Spiritual from the father, together with a certain limbus from the purest things of nature around it; but with those who come into Heaven this limbus is below and the Spiritual above, whereas with those who come into Hell this limbus is above and the Spiritual below. (See DLW 257:5. DWis 8. 7.)
